config.label: ChainMemory API key
config.description: ChainMemory API key. REQUIRED for every tool except chainmemory_seal. Get one at https://faucet.chainmemory.ai

config.label: 12-word BIP-39 phrase for the blind vault
config.description: 12-word BIP-39 phrase for the blind vault. Optional: without it the server works exactly as before, but sealed:true is unavailable. Generate one with chainmemory_new_seed. It never leaves your machine and cannot be recovered.

config.label: NOT NEEDED for normal use — leave it empty
config.description: NOT NEEDED for normal use — leave it empty. Only the chainmemory_seal tool reads it, to sign a contract call yourself instead of letting the API anchor the memory (which chainmemory_remember already does). If you do set it, it is a wallet private key: use a dedicated wallet holding only a few AIC, never your main one. No other tool uses it.

config.label: RPC endpoint used only by chainmemory_seal (default: https://rpc
config.description: RPC endpoint used only by chainmemory_seal (default: https://rpc.chainmemory.ai). Leave it empty unless you set AICHAIN_KEY.
